name: motif_add_feature_value
description:
Author a feature value. Research first: motif_guide topic feature-conditioned-slots; check best practice. Use only if the structure must carry or require this feature value; otherwise use an inflection class for arbitrary stem groups. Restrict by feature value instead of copying affixes or slots per value (guide feature-conditioned-slots). Stages a closed feature specification in an existing or earlier-staged structure, with value omitted when unchosen. Inflectional affix requirements use current morphosyntactic definitions, and any supplied value must belong to the exact feature. Only a person can Apply.
Command: compose-author-feature-value. Agent class: Draft.
